title: Just What We Needed
text: Just What We Needed. My husband just finished installing hardwood flooring in our bedroom. We have several rugs in place because we have an elderly cat that spends most of his time in the room. A couple of the rugs were sliding around when we walked on them. Luckily they didn't slip for him, but we didn't want to risk it. We had to trim this down to fit the intended rug, but there was enough left over to use on another rug. It works very well and we haven't had any issues with sliding rugs since!

product_metadata.title: FestiCorp Non Slip Rug Pads 5x7 Ft Non Skid Rug Pad Gripper, Anti-Slip Carpet Rug Mats for Under Rugs and Hard Surface Floors
features: Non-Slip Rug Pad: Our extra grip non slip rug pads can hold your rugs in place and prevent them from sliding or bunching during everyday use. The carpet pad can provide additional thickness and cushion for your rug and protect floors from scratches and damage.

Durable And Strong Grippers: These non-slip mats are made with premium PVC material which is completely non-toxic and safe for your health, the open grid weave technology allows continuous air flow and circulation under your rug ultimately making the rug easier to vacuuming.

Multi-functional Pads: The versatile area rug pad is perfect to be put on hardwood, laminate, concrete, tile, marble and etc. The multifunctional non skid rug pad is also suitable for futons, couch cushions, mattresses, and sofa covers, or for shelf and drawer protection.

Perfect Fit: Comes with an anti-slip rug pad that measures 5’ x 7', which can easily be trimmed with household scissors to fit any custom size and shape. Ideally the rug pad should be cut approximately 1”-2" shorter of the rug perimeter.

Easy Installation And Use: Place the carpet mats on a clean dry floor and smooth out the wrinkles. The lightweight non-adhesive design makes it super easy to add or move the pad without leave sticky stains. Please note the pad can only be used on the flat hard surface.
